tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards, the canvas and the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, widgets, tables, dialogs, sheets, popovers, inputs. The chart surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, the sidebar, code and SQL wells, skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, table row rules, dividers. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects, checkboxes and secondary buttons (3:1 on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures, on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, axis and tick labels, table headers; on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and placeholders only (exempt from text contrast); never for information.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, active navigation, selected tab, links; as text on surface, surface-raised and accent-soft. The logo's ocean blue (#287a9a, deepened for text contrast; the logo's sky blue in dark).

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills and links. Light: the logo's navy.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active sidebar item, certified badge fill, filter chip when applied.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent or accent-strong fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour: solid 2px ring with a 2px surface gap (see focus-ring shadow).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links: an alias of accent.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: On track / Green / passed check. Darker than the logo green so it stays apart from amber for colour-blind readers. Always with the check-circle icon and a word; as text on surface-raised and status-ok-soft.

tokens.name: status-ok-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind status-ok text in status badges and passed-check rows.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: At risk / Amber / stale data / warning. Always with the triangle icon and a word; as text on surface-raised and status-warn-soft.

tokens.name: status-warn-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind status-warn text; stale-data and partial-scope notices.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Off track / Red / failed check / destructive action / error. Always with the octagon icon and a word; as text on surface-raised and status-danger-soft.

tokens.name: status-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind status-danger text; error cards and failed-check rows.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a status-danger fill (the destructive button label).

tokens.name: personal
tokens.usage: Personal (uncertified) definitions and drafts; as text on surface-raised and personal-soft. Never used for status.

tokens.name: personal-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the Personal badge.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: brand-ocean
tokens.usage: Logo ocean blue. Brand moments only (logo, cover, sign-in, empty-state art); never status or series.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Logo navy. Brand moments only.

tokens.name: brand-sky
tokens.usage: Logo sky blue. Brand moments only.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: Logo green. Brand moments only; never as a chart series (green means On track).

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Logo orange. Brand moments only.

tokens.name: brand-yellow
tokens.usage: Logo yellow. Brand moments only; fails text contrast on light grounds, so never for text.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Series slot 1 (ocean blue, from the logo). Single-series charts use only this slot.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Series slot 2 (orange, from the logo).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Series slot 3 (magenta).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Series slot 4 (amber-brown).

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Series slot 5 (plum).

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Series slot 6 (gold, the logo's yellow at chart strength).

tokens.name: chart-7
tokens.usage: Series slot 7 (violet).

tokens.name: chart-8
tokens.usage: Series slot 8 (sea green, from the logo). A ninth series folds into Other (chart-other).

tokens.name: vivid-1
tokens.usage: Vivid chart colour 1 (blue; ENH-027): the Vivid chart scheme and the Aurora layout's charts and colour chips. No red or green, which mean project health.

tokens.name: vivid-2
tokens.usage: Vivid chart colour 2 (orange; ENH-027): the Vivid chart scheme and the Aurora layout's charts and colour chips. No red or green, which mean project health.

tokens.name: vivid-3
tokens.usage: Vivid chart colour 3 (magenta; ENH-027): the Vivid chart scheme and the Aurora layout's charts and colour chips. No red or green, which mean project health.

tokens.name: vivid-4
tokens.usage: Vivid chart colour 4 (violet; ENH-027): the Vivid chart scheme and the Aurora layout's charts and colour chips. No red or green, which mean project health.

tokens.name: vivid-5
tokens.usage: Vivid chart colour 5 (teal; ENH-027): the Vivid chart scheme and the Aurora layout's charts and colour chips. No red or green, which mean project health.

tokens.name: vivid-6
tokens.usage: Vivid chart colour 6 (gold; ENH-027): the Vivid chart scheme and the Aurora layout's charts and colour chips. No red or green, which mean project health.

tokens.name: vivid-7
tokens.usage: Vivid chart colour 7 (indigo; ENH-027): the Vivid chart scheme and the Aurora layout's charts and colour chips. No red or green, which mean project health.

tokens.name: vivid-8
tokens.usage: Vivid chart colour 8 (orchid; ENH-027): the Vivid chart scheme and the Aurora layout's charts and colour chips. No red or green, which mean project health.

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: The Other bucket and de-emphasised comparison series (previous period).

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines (hairline, recessive).

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Chart baseline and axis line (3:1 on surface-raised).

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential ocean-blue ramp, lowest magnitude (heatmap near zero).

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential ocean-blue ramp, step 2.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential ocean-blue ramp, step 3.

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential ocean-blue ramp, step 4 (the logo's ocean and sky blues).

tokens.name: seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential ocean-blue ramp, highest magnitude.

tokens.name: div-neg-2
tokens.usage: Diverging, strongly below baseline (the logo's orange pole), e.g. far over budget.

tokens.name: div-neg-1
tokens.usage: Diverging, slightly below baseline.

tokens.name: div-mid
tokens.usage: Diverging midpoint: on plan, no change. Always grey.

tokens.name: div-pos-1
tokens.usage: Diverging, slightly above baseline.

tokens.name: div-pos-2
tokens.usage: Diverging, strongly above baseline (the logo's blue pole).

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: The platform system font (SF Pro, Segoe UI, Roboto); no web font is downloaded. A dense 14px base: Tela is read at a desk, beside the data.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles: a dashboard, report or admin screen name. One per page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headings, dialog and sheet titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Widget and card titles, table group headers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Counts risks with status Open in projects you can see.
styles.usage: All interface text, answers, definitions, form labels.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Buttons, emphasised values in sentences, active navigation.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, as-of lines, helper text, axis and tick labels, badges.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows: sidebar group names and KPI labels. Never for sentences.

groups.name: Figures
groups.note: The platform monospace (SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas) for numbers people compare: KPI values, table figures, SQL.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The headline value of a KPI card or answer card.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Numeric table cells and deltas; right-aligned.

styles.name: code
styles.sample: SELECT count(*) FROM risks WHERE status = 'Open'
styles.usage: Generated SQL, custom SQL editor, IDs and request ids.

spacing.note: 4px base. Dense layouts step by 4 and 8; page rhythm by 24 and 32.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between chips, table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding, between form rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and widget padding, the mobile page gutter, gap between widgets.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections, desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page header and content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

radius.note: Small and square-ish: Tela is an instrument, not a toy. Pills only for filter chips and avatars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs, checkboxes, table selection.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, menus, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, widgets, dialogs, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Filter chips, avatars, the unread dot.

shadow.note: Hairlines first. Shadows only for things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the command palette, toasts, dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-drag
tokens.usage: A widget or list row while it is being dragged.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px surface gap, then 2px of focus (box-shadow, so it follows the radius).

size.note: Fixed sizes for controls and frame.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons and inputs in toolbars and table rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input and select height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The ask box and primary page actions.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar; collapses to 56px (icons only) or a drawer below 1024px.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar with breadcrumbs, the ask bar and the user menu.
